## What we do

- 📄 **Document Automation** — documents from any source are checked against company rules and land in 1C as ready drafts
- 🤖 **AI Agents & RPA** — agents handle tasks in your systems and answer questions on company documents; RPA robots repeat employees' actions in software
- 🔗 **1C & Bitrix24 Integration** — 1C, Bitrix24, the website and marketplaces exchange data on their own: entered once, matching everywhere
- 📊 **Business Intelligence** — every department counts by the same formulas, and each manager sees their metrics with plan and actual
- 🧠 **ML & Data Science** — we find causes and losses in your data; models forecast demand, risks and purchases in advance
- 🌐 **Web Services & Internal Systems** — customer accounts, portals and internal systems built around your process and connected to 1C and CRM
